_comment: Caps on structural-debt signals under dblift/, consumed by scripts/check_debt_ratchet.py. Counts must stay flat or shrink by default. A narrowly scoped compatibility-boundary exception may raise a cap only when the same change records its measured delta and compatibility rationale in _policy. Freed headroom must not be reused: lower the cap in the same pull request that lowers the count.
_policy: Initial measurement on develop fdfe3be (2026-09-21); tightened on develop 1f2a12e after unreachable code was removed; tightened again after the post-commit table probe was removed from the migration engine. Comment-only lines are never counted. function_level_imports: package imports below module level. any_annotations: non-import lines using Any in a type. dynamic_attribute_access: lines calling getattr/hasattr. broad_excepts: 'except Exception' handlers. large_files: modules over 800 lines. process_references: lines naming an internal tracking identifier (epic/story numbers, ticket ids); held at 0. any_annotations raised by 1 for SqlGeneratorProtocol.generate_schema_script(options: Optional[Any]): its real type, ScriptOptions, lives in the generator package that dblift/db must not import, and object would make BaseSqlGenerator fail the Protocol. SQL Server nullable rendering adds two optional metadata reads (expected_data_type and data_type_diff) so older extension diff objects safely decline without a type. SQL Server type rendering adds three optional-read lines for nullable_diff, expected_nullable and expected_column.nullable; both generator diff shapes must be supported, and absent metadata must decline rather than guess. Oracle identity capture implements the existing enhance_columns Any-typed hook (+1 annotation line), and rendering reads optional identity_generation (+1) for legacy column compatibility. SQLite type rendering adds one optional data_type_diff read, following the existing column rendering hook contract. Tightened after the text undo generator was removed, and again after the legacy regex, hybrid and SQLGlot parsers were removed, and once more after the parser factory and the statement analyzer were removed. dynamic_attribute_access and broad_excepts raised by 1 each for the end-of-migration provider hook in ExecutionEngine: providers and test doubles that predate finish_migration_statements must still run, and any error the hook raises (a driver error on a recompile, not only DBLift's own) must be recorded as a failed migration rather than escape the history write. Optional command presentation preserves existing logger and subclass contracts through lazy facade exports and a shared adapter. Measured against the preceding source: function_level_imports 321 to 326 (+5), including three TYPE_CHECKING imports counted by the lexical checker and required lazy compatibility imports; any_annotations 1068 to 1074 (+6) for legacy keyword forwarding, heterogeneous query cells, the forwarded footer argument dictionary and formatter alias facade, avoiding single-use interface types; dynamic_attribute_access 988 to 989 (+1) for optional CLI client/executor composition. Other structural counts are unchanged. These increases are limited to the optional presentation compatibility boundary. Static compatibility of the lazy logger aliases additionally requires two TYPE_CHECKING-only imports: the three public formatter facade classes and the legacy JsonFormatter alias. This moves function_level_imports from 326 to 328 (+2; +7 against the source baseline of 321) because the lexical checker counts type-only imports. The legacy JINJA_AVAILABLE boolean also retains its static annotation inside TYPE_CHECKING. Runtime AST outside these blocks and all other measured counts remain unchanged. Db2 caller-owned migration-lock preparation catches the bare Exception propagated by ibm_db_dbi for SQL0911N/68, classifies only Db2 lock conflicts as a busy lease, and re-raises other errors. This raises broad_excepts from 327 to 328 (+1); narrowing to SQLAlchemyError would miss the observed driver exception. dynamic_attribute_access tightened from 987 to 985 after the failed-migration
